Welcome to ResourcePacker v1.0.0
ResourcePacker is licensed under the MIT License.
Copyright (c) 2025 David Grueneis
Source code available at: https://github.com/DaveGreen-Games/ShapeEngine
Use at your own risk. No warranties provided.
ResourcePacker can:
 - pack directories into binary files using gzip with this layout:
  - Total Files packed (4 bytes).
  - Total Bytes packed (8 bytes). Used for offset to skip data block.
  - Data block with [path length][path][data length][data] layout. path length & data length have 4 bytes.
  - Index with [path length][path][data length] layout used for fast random access.
 - unpack packed binary files into directories.
 - pack directories into text files with this layout:
  - Data block with each resource file taking up 2 lines:
   - 1st line = filename.
   - 2nd line = binary data of the file compressed to a string.
  - Empty Line.
  - Number of packed files.
 - unpack text files into directories.

Use 'help' for usage instructions.
Run commands either from the built executable or through the .NET tool command 'shapeengine-resourcepacker'.
Remarks:
 - ResourcePacker does not modify or delete any source files or directories.
 - Using .txt extension for the sourceFilePath in unpack or the outputFilePath in pack uses the text based packing system. Any other extensions will use the binary packing system.
 - Ensure you have the necessary permissions for file operations in the specified directories.
------------------------------------------------------------
Commands:
  shapeengine-resourcepacker --help
  shapeengine-resourcepacker help
  shapeengine-resourcepacker pack <sourceDirectoryPath> <outputFilePath>
  shapeengine-resourcepacker unpack <sourceFilePath> <outputDirectoryPath>
Flags:
  --exceptions <.ext1> <.ext2> ... : Optional flag to specify file extensions to exclude when packing/unpacking directories.
  --debug : Optional flag to enable debug mode for detailed logging during operations.
  --parallel : Optional flag to enable parallel packing/unpacking possible increasing speed at the cost of increase memory usage.
Examples:
  shapeengine-resourcepacker pack ./backgroundMusic ./packedMusic.res
  shapeengine-resourcepacker pack ./assets ./packedResources.txt
  shapeengine-resourcepacker pack ./assets ./build/release/packedAssets.res --exceptions .txt .png .wav --debug
